model_system: 3D tight-binding model of an ordinary magnetoelectric insulator (Appendix A)

key_params.boundary_conditions: periodic boundary conditions for bulk calculation; compared against bounded-sample calculations
key_params.regime: independent-particle insulating phase with broken inversion and time-reversal symmetry
key_params.validation_strategy: compare finite-field numerical differentiation and perturbation-theory formulas for alpha

headline_claim: The linear magnetoelectric susceptibility of the 3D tight-binding model computed under periodic boundary conditions agrees excellently with bounded-sample calculations.
replication_difficulty: high - reproducing requires implementing finite-field orbital magnetization and perturbative OMP formulas for a 3D insulating tight-binding model, with careful gauge-consistent k-space numerics.
